decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (12346_02_C11_00_D1, 12346_02_C11_01_D1, 12346_02_C11_02_D1, 12346_02_C11_03_D1, 12346_02_C11_04_D1, 12346_02_C11_05_D1, 12346_02_C11_06_D1, 12346_02_C11_07_D1, 12346_02_C11_08_D1, Design & Access Statement, Transport Statement, Energy Assessment (Issue 1), Code for Sustainable Homes Pre-Assessment Report (Issue 1) Received 04/07/2012 and approved under 00814/D/P1.
DFCC L486-03 Revision D, DFCC L486-03 Revision C received 28/07/2016.
Arboricultural Appraisal Report, dated 19/04/2016 produced by Complete Tree Care Ltd and received on 28/07/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The replacement planting shown on plan ref. DFCC L486-03 Revision D hereby approved shall be carried out within the first planting season following the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - If within a period of two years from the date of the planting of any tree approved under this application, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation

Condition : 4 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - The loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shown on drawing No. 12346_02_C11_02_D1 received on 04/07/2012 and approved under 00814/D/P1 shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 6 - The dwelling shall be constructed in accordance with The Code For Sustainable Homes Final Certificate (Issued at the Post Construction Stage) 120A Northfield Road, Hounslow, London TW5 9JG Received: 22/09/2015 approved under 00814/D/P2(11). All the measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.
Condition : 9 - The windows formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Variation of condition 5 (hard and soft landscape) and condition 6 (trees) of planning permission 00814/D/P2 dated 30/10/2014 for Removal of condition 23 (Window of Bedroom 3) of planning permission 00814/D/P1 dated 19/11/2012 for construction of a two storey detached four bedroom house
